columns.insuredTokenHelp: An asset eligible for a claim after a covered loss incident, subject to insurance score and claim rules.
columns.maxCoverageHelp: Current onchain maximum reimbursement for each listed token. Actual payout depends on the user's insurance score and cover pool limits.

coverageHelp: Covers the conversion of {symbol} to {underlying}. If the amount of {underlying} you get for each {symbol} drops by more than 20%, you can file a claim. Note: {underlying} itself is not covered.
